summary: Fees changed 51.50-62.50 -> 44-62 from the operator's posted table (weekday 30-amp back-in $44; engine's Oct 2026 Saturday quote $51.50 kept in the fee note). Added 50 online RV sites to 42 ft, showers/flush/laundry (camp store confirmed), season May 1-Oct 18, CampLife URL and the 3-night holiday minimum. Hookups (manual) and Good Sam/military (directory) left as they are. Note: dropped 'Open April to October' (season field; the park says May 1) and 'camp store' (facilities).
flags: Private gate facts (borderline on price): the operator's own rate table posts $44 Sunday-Thursday / $47 Friday-Saturday for a 30-amp back-in under 36 ft (a 23-ft motorhome fits; MOTORHOME is an allowed type), rates including 2 adults and 3 children, no per-night fees named. But CampLife's live quote for Saturday 2026-10-17 was $51.50 for that site type ($4.50 above the table's $47), and CampLife's description says back-ins from $46. So a weekday night is $44-48.50 and a Saturday $47-51.50 depending on which the park charges; 2027 isn't loaded ('subject to a rate increase'). Good Sam Park (stored good_sam true, directory): 10% off brings even $51.50 to $46.35. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Point Pelee NP 92 km). Family has not stayed. Presence passes: working website + phone (567) 230-6499 and CampLife online booking. Google Maps 4.3 stars from 242 reviews.
Long-stay tests: seasonal sites exist ('Seasonal Spots ... Call to inquire'; 'Daily/Monthly Rates' on CampLife), but 50 RV sites plus 19 tent sites are sold nightly online, so tests 2 and 4 pass.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront, audited 2026-10-15 on satellite: pond rim is swim beach, engine's waterfront type not confirmed at the pads): the operator's own rate table now also sells 'Back In Waterfront <34'' sites ($49-57), and CampLife lists 'Waterview Sites' and 'Creek Access & View' on some back-ins - an operator water claim contrary to ours, so a re-audit lead only.
